newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate panel approves product liability bill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate panel approves product liability bill.

text.p: Senate Commerce Committee Republicans Thursday approved a bill to limit damages in product liability suits. It passed 11-9 on a party line vote and now goes to the full Senate where opponents promised a long debate.
The bill would limit punitive damages in product liability suits to twice the compensatory damages or $250,000, whichever is greater. President Clinton vetoed a similar bill last year.
Sen. Slade Gorton, R-Washington state, said this bill was changed to eliminate many of Clinton's objections but Sen. Jay Rockefeller, D-West Virginia, said the changes were minor.
